note: Chat-HITL PROGRAM ACCEPTANCE manifest (cinatra#2573, epic #2564 S7). One row per LITERAL acceptance criterion in #2573's issue body — 16, verbatim and in order; the gate pins them against its own CANONICAL_CRITERIA so a row can never drift from the issue's wording. `disposition` is the row's honest state: MAPPED (already fully proven by a landed slice's own test — S7 never re-authors what a sibling owns), BUILT (S7's own artifact, because the criterion had no owner), MISSING (not proven; `gap` says why, in a sentence, and `partial` marks a criterion whose clauses are only partly met). Hand-authored against the issue text — there is no regeneration mode and there must not be one, because the rows are claims a human makes, not facts a scanner discovers. Every {file, testName} pair is re-verified against the real tree on every run of the gate. VERSION 2 (2026-08-13, the finisher round): the two S7-found defects landed on main — D-1 cinatra#2710 (`7123d2bf1`, the run-detail screen's parallel recommendation renderer deleted) and D-2 cinatra#2711 (`6b4c3e887`, the composer binds to a focused review card) — and the owner ruled on the three open questions in coordination-tracker entry 334: the releasable binding stands (answer 1), the AC-13 'no island' clause is SUPERSEDED by the 2026-08-11 full-parity correction (answer 2), and dev-runtime-LABELED captures are authoritative for dispatch-dependent cells (answer 3). Rows carry a `ruling` field naming the entry and answer that moved them, and a `note` field carrying what a reader would otherwise have to reconstruct — including, on AC-15, the one cell that is still open and the exact predicate that gates it. VERSION 3 (2026-08-15, the truthful-contracts round): the spec pin moved to the ratified drawing and the drift is recorded in `specCommitDrift`; AC-3 and AC-15 are MISSING with the absent cells named. Neither criterion is weakened and no proof is deleted: what is withdrawn is the CLAIM that the named proofs meet the criterion. AC-3's tests prove the schedule transaction and never draw the card the criterion asks a reader to confirm; AC-15's captures cover one card of four and never had a schedule or verification cell. The strict mode therefore reports NOT READY again, which is the honest state of the program, and the sibling one-card gate now fails its done-check while any kind is still a placeholder — so no later slice can be accepted by the same reading that accepted these gaps.

THE FENCE: `assertScriptedProviderNotProduction` (packages/llm/src/scripted-test-provider.ts) throws unless CINATRA_RUNTIME_MODE === 'development' AND NODE_ENV !== 'production'; `lifecycleSeedEnvVerdict` FENCE 1a (src/lib/test-support/lifecycle-seed-fence.ts) answers 404 production-build on NODE_ENV === 'production' before it reads any other gate. `next start` sets NODE_ENV=production and Next inlines that value into the server bundle at build time, so a production-equivalent build and an LLM-backed dispatch are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE by construction. Both fences are shipped product safety, not test scaffolding, and this lane weakened neither. WHAT IS PROVEN.
